name: Mega Man Heavy Fat-Tire Rammer
tagline: Heavy-Caliber Mirror-Chrome Torpedo Bar & Fat 5-Ribbed Mega Man Tires
description: Unmistakable heavy-caliber Mega Man industrial contraption kart built on 4 extra-wide 5-ribbed pneumatic tires (R=11u/12.5u, hw=6.2u) with deep-dish off-white stamped steel rims, zinc hex nuts, yellow cotter pins and brass Schrader valves. Features double-decker stainless tubular cage rails, brushed stainless floorpan, an industrial charcoal/off-white bucket seat, rear chrome/brass Mega-Engine with swept-up megaphones, and a colossal front mirror-chrome bullet-nosed torpedo bar clamped in a TIG-welded stainless T-collar.
highlights: Colossal R=3.55u mirror-chrome bullet-nosed torpedo bar (X=+7..+58) in TIG T-collar & diagonal struts
4 extra-wide (hw=6.2u) 5-ribbed Mega Man tires on off-white stamped steel rims w/ cotter pins & valves
Double-decker brushed stainless tubular cage (|Y|>=14.2), diamond floorpan & rear axle gussets
Exposed chrome/brass finned Mega-Engine block, velocity stack & dual swept-up chrome megaphones
Open overhead cockpit (22u wide torso box 100% clear), seat (-9, 0, 10), wheel (+13, 0, 24.5)
